title: Wolf Workspace MCP tool call
description: A tools/call request of the compact Wolf Workspace MCP server (wolfsdk.mcp-workspace.v1, Streamable HTTP). `name` is one of the eight tools in `x-wolfsdk-tools`; `arguments` validates against the inputSchema of the tool with that name. The tool list, serialized, stays under 14000 UTF-8 bytes so an agent pays under 3500 tokens for it. `$defs` documents members of tool results that the tool list does not carry.

workspace_list_pack.description: One entry of `packs` in the workspace_list result. `definitions` is there when the server has the pack manifests; a server with only a pack refresher lists pack, bindings and title.

definitions.description: Each binding, in the order of bindings.

pack_binding_definition.description: What one pack binding reads and writes. The value is read from the room's head of the source workbook, as stored (a formula cell holds its cached value); a refresh may recalculate first. A source that can not be read leaves value out and says why in problem.

id.description: Binding id, as pack_link_refresh takes it.

selector.description: The manifest selector (wolfsdk.pack.v1): {type: cell or range, sheet, ref}, {type: table, name} or {type: defined_name, name}.

source_doc.description: Workspace document holding the source; null when the binding names no source of the pack.

source_address.description: Agent API address of the cells the binding reads, for doc_read: sheet:<name>/cell:<A1> or sheet:<name>/range:<A1>:<A1>, with a defined name or a table resolved to its cells. null when a defined name is a constant or the source could not be resolved.

source_revision.description: Revision of source_doc the value was read at.

value.description: Current source value: one value for a cell or constant, rows of values for a range or table. null is an empty cell.

value_truncated.description: value holds the first 50 cells of the range only; doc_read source_address for the rest.

target_doc.description: DOCX or PPTX document the binding writes into.

target_address.description: Agent API address of the target in target_doc, for doc_read; a docx_bookmark is bookmark:<name>.

problem.description: Why the source address or value is missing.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: workspace_list
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: List the workspace's documents, packs, open proposals and open comment threads. Start here: each document shows its format, head revision and sha256; each pack binding its source cells, current value and target; each thread its thread_id, anchor and messages.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: doc_read
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Read a document's head. Returns its revision (pass it as base_revision when editing) and the requested view.

view.description: cells: XLSX values and formulas of target.

target.description: Address, for example sheet:#1/range:A1:K50 or para:~2a9256c0. Default: the whole document.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: doc_search
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Search text and cell values across the workspace. Returns hits with doc, address, snippet and revision.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: doc_create
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Create a document, blank or as a copy of template, optionally applying one op batch. Fails if the name exists.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: doc_edit
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Edit a document with one Agent API op batch. DOCX: use replace-text (target, find, replace) for words, or set (target, value.text) for whole text. PPTX: use replace-text for words, or set (target, value.text) for whole shape text. XLSX: use set (target, value.string) for cell text. PDF is read-only. Use propose for review, commit to change the head; on REVISION_MISMATCH re-read, rebase, retry.

base_revision.description: Revision the ops were written against, from doc_read.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: doc_inspect_visual
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Render pages of a document, or of a proposal's preview, as PNG images. Set preflight to get page count, size and image cost without rendering.

proposal_id.description: Render this proposal's preview instead of the head.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: pack_link_refresh
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Refresh a pack: recalculate its sources and rewrite the bound Word and PowerPoint targets as reviewable edits.

x-wolfsdk-tools.name: comment_reply
x-wolfsdk-tools.description: Reply to an open comment thread; thread_id comes from workspace_list. Mention people or agents with @id in body.
